articles.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
articles.description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
articles.description: Everful has raised $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct sourcing platform, helping retailers source products from overseas manufacturers.
articles.author: Kate Park

articles.title: Anthropic hits NASDAQ exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
articles.description: Anthropic's IPO price was set at $83, representing more than $80 billion in new capital raised.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: At Nasdaq opening bell, Anthropic CEO recommits to pacing AI development
articles.description: In his Nasdaq opening bell speech, Dario Amodei reiterated Anthropic's commitment to pacing AI development, regardless of business or political pressure.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Anthropic’s IPO puts AI’s circular financing boom to the test
articles.description: Anthropic faces enormous compute commitments as it goes public, but its biggest infrastructure partners, including Amazon and Google, could continue profiting from AI even if Anthropic loses its lead.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Superhuman pushes its Go assistant everywhere
articles.description: Superhuman is making Go its central agent and making it available in Docs and Mail
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is ‘unpatchable’
articles.description: The Microsoft CEO downplayed the recent Outlook outage while noting that AI was causing both opportunities and new challenges for securing much of the connected world.
